title: Comparison bound for every outcome
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $l$ be a finite list in $\alpha$. For every outcome $(a,c)$ in the support of the randomized selection procedure on input $(k,l)$, the number $c$ of comparisons satisfies $2c\le |l|(|l|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: The outcome lies in the support of the procedure
